activity.notes: After defeating Harold II at Hastings, William was crowned King of England at Westminster Abbey on 25 December 1066 and reigned until his death on 9 September 1087. This English kingship is a distinct concurrent sovereign Activity from his continuing rule as Duke of Normandy. The existing Kingdom of England polity and generic King role are reused.

sources.title: The Royal Family — William I 'The Conqueror' (r. 1066-1087)
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family states that William was crowned at Westminster Abbey on Christmas Day 1066 and died on 9 September 1087.

sources.title: Historic Royal Palaces — Kings and Queens of England and Britain
sources.citation_text: Historic Royal Palaces identifies William I the Conqueror as the Norman King of England reigning from 1066 to 1087.
